on darkModeForTime(secondsToday) return secondsToday < 36000 or secondsToday >= 72000 end darkModeForTime
on run set useDarkMode to darkModeForTime(time of (current date)) tell application "System Events" tell appearance preferences if dark mode is not useDarkMode then set dark mode to useDarkMode end tell end tell do shell script "/usr/bin/defaults write -g AppleInterfaceStyleSwitchesAutomatically -bool false" end run
